newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany jails neo-Nazi for spreading propaganda.
newsitem.headline: Germany jails neo-Nazi for spreading propaganda.

text.p: A German court on Monday sentenced a leading member of a right-wing extremist group to one year in jail for spreading neo-Nazi propaganda.
The court found Hans-Christian Wendt, a 25-year-old journalist and member of the "Die Nationalen" group, guilty of inciting racial hatred.
In its judgment, the court branded Wendt "one of the leading figures in the extremist scene" in the Berlin area.
Investigators found anti-Semitic literature, including material which denied the Holocaust had taken place, when they raided Wendt's home in August .
